project: WSR-002+003 durable Worker capture and replay-parity recording
description: Implement WSR-002 and WSR-003 as one coherent delivery: Recordings subscribes to each recorded Worker topic, durably accepts the authoritative opening before provider handoff, captures the complete ordered Worker history, replays it through the same deterministic reducer, and validates portable recordings with truthful streaming, snapshot, and final-only provider fidelity.

context.customerAsk: Implement WSR-002 and WSR-003 of the Worker Session Recordings plan as one coherent PR. Recordings must subscribe to the Worker topic through events.Service.Subscribe with a durable opening barrier gating provider handoff; a completed recording must reproduce live history exactly through the same reducer, preserve honest streaming, snapshot, and final-only fidelity, pass portable validation, and provide WSR-FT-001 through WSR-FT-006 evidence.
context.problem: The WSR-001 Worker topic is provider-neutral, opening-first, and replay-readable, but Events is process-local and does not make that history durable. Provider execution can escape capture unless handoff waits for a durably recorded opening, and separate live, replay, or portable reduction paths can disagree or fabricate fidelity for providers that do not stream.
context.solution: Recordings owns one Worker-recording lifecycle that subscribes to the canonical Worker topic, durably validates and persists SESSION/STARTED before releasing provider handoff, consumes every record once through terminal, and uses one pure reducer for live capture and both completed and portable replay. A strict portable contract preserves provider-neutral provenance and actual delivery fidelity while rejecting invalid identity, order, lifecycle, integrity, idempotency, terminal, or fidelity claims without introducing a Worker Sessions-to-Recordings dual write.

acceptanceCriteria: Recordings consumes every recorded Worker Session through events.Service.Subscribe on the canonical Worker topic; Worker Sessions publishes once to Events and does not directly write Worker payloads into Recordings.

Provider handoff occurs only after Recordings durably persists and acknowledges the authoritative position-1 SESSION/STARTED; opening, subscription, persistence, gap, cancellation, close, and backpressure failures prevent handoff and cannot expose terminal-only or silently incomplete history.

A completed recording contains every accepted Worker record exactly once in topic order from opening through one legal durable terminal record, and completion is not observable before all preceding records are durable.

Live capture, completed-recording replay, and portable-import replay use the same deterministic reducer, reproduce equal observable history and fidelity, and invoke no Workers or Providers during replay.

Portable validation accepts truthful streaming, snapshot, final-only, and no-Provider-Session-reference histories; rejects malformed identity, ordering, lifecycle, duplicate source identity, integrity, terminal, provenance, or unsupported fidelity claims; and WSR-FT-001 through WSR-FT-006 pass.
Typecheck and tests pass; no NEW lint violations relative to current main, and the gates green on main (backend-size, pkg-maint, pkg-file-count, pkg-structure, vet) stay green.

The implementation/review loop continues until required CI is terminal and passing, all blocking PR conversation feedback is explicitly addressed, merge conflicts and concurrent shared/generated-file changes are resolved against current main, and the PR is actually merged; an opened, green, approved, or ready-to-merge PR is not complete.

userStories.title: Gate provider handoff on a durable recorded opening
userStories.description: As a customer who enables Worker recording, I want the recording to be durably open before provider execution starts so a fast or failing provider cannot escape capture.
acceptanceCriteria: Recordings opens an events.Service.Subscribe subscription for the exact Worker Session topic from the beginning of history before provider handoff is eligible to run.

The barrier releases provider handoff only after position 1 is verified as the authoritative correlated SESSION/STARTED and that exact record, topic position, and source identity are durably persisted.
A duplicate opening is idempotent only when identity and payload agree; a missing, non-position-1, contradictory, or malformed opening fails recording and does not invoke the provider.

Subscribe, durable-write, retention-gap, closed-source, cancellation, and backpressure outcomes before barrier release produce explicit classified failure, no false completion or terminal-only recording, and zero provider calls.
Concurrent opening and scheduling cannot cross the barrier out of order, cancellation cannot release a blocked handoff, and focused race tests pass.
WSR-FT-004 proves through the canonical root-built path that opening durability precedes the first provider call and an opening failure yields zero provider calls.
WSR-FT-001, WSR-FT-002, and WSR-FT-003 remain green for opening-first ordering, stable correlation, provider attribution, provider-neutral lifecycle, and honest pre-recording fidelity.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed. Pre-barrier opening-append failure aborts and joins the capture with durable OPENING_INVALID classification; Worker Sessions uses an explicit recorder dependency, production logger injection, and runtime recording identity input. WSR-FT-004 now proves through the canonical root-built process that a real durable opening is observed before the first provider command and that a durable opening failure records PERSISTENCE_FAILED with identity and yields zero provider calls. Focused and race-enabled coverage passes. WSR-FT-005 is complete with story 002, and portable fidelity is complete with story 003.

userStories.title: Finalize and replay the exact captured Worker history
userStories.description: As a customer inspecting completed work, I want replay to reproduce exactly what was observed live so historical inspection has no alternate interpretation of the Worker Session.
acceptanceCriteria: After the opening barrier, Recordings consumes each Worker-topic record exactly once in ascending aggregate position and advances its durable cursor only with the accepted record.
Conflicting duplicates, skipped positions, retention gaps, unexpected close or backpressure, records after terminal, or multiple terminals fail completion; an identical redelivery is idempotent.
Recording completion becomes observable only after one legal terminal Worker lifecycle record and every preceding accepted record are durable; provider completion alone cannot finalize early.

Live capture and completed replay call the same pure deterministic reducer over the same canonical Worker record values, and replay invokes no Workers, Providers, provider transcript readers, clocks, or process/network effects.

Replay history equals the live finalized history in order, topic positions, opening timestamp and correlations, provider binding, normalized records, provenance, delivery, representation, fidelity, source identity, and terminal outcome.
Incomplete or failed capture cannot be presented as completed replay parity.
WSR-FT-005 proves exact live-to-replay equality, terminal-last behavior, no duplicates, and zero provider invocations during replay.
Focused Recordings lifecycle, reducer, subscription, replay, and race tests pass.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed. Canonical Wire now retains the same durable Worker recording writer instance for capture and its existing WorkerRecordingReader read side; the neutral application Process carries that read capability and pkg/root narrows it without widening the Recordings service-root interface inventory. Root-built WSR-FT-005 reloads the completed snapshot, replays it through the existing pure reducer, proves exact live projection equality, terminal-last ordering, unique source identities, and zero provider calls during replay. Focused Recordings, root, Wire, and race coverage passes; WSR-FT-006 and portable-fidelity evidence are complete with story 003.

userStories.title: Preserve honest provider fidelity in portable recordings
userStories.description: As a customer moving a completed recording between installations, I want portable replay to preserve exactly what the provider supplied and clearly state its fidelity so I can trust the history without provider-specific access.
acceptanceCriteria: A completed portable Worker recording contains the ordered canonical Worker records and detached identity, lifecycle, correlation, provider attribution, provenance, delivery, representation, fidelity, source-idempotency, terminal, compatibility, and integrity facts required by the shared reducer.

Streaming histories preserve actual incremental records, snapshot histories preserve authoritative snapshots without invented deltas, and final-only histories preserve synthesized lifecycle plus final authoritative output without claiming streaming capability.
Export, decode, validate, and replay produce the same reducer result as the completed live recording for representative streaming, snapshot, final-only, and no-Provider-Session-reference fixtures.

Portable validation rejects unsupported compatibility, unknown fields, malformed or mismatched identity, non-opening position 1, gaps or reordering, contradictory duplicates, invalid lifecycle or provenance, provider output before binding, records after terminal, missing or multiple terminals, integrity mismatch, and fidelity claims unsupported by the contained history.
Validation failure returns a stable actionable diagnostic and exposes neither a usable completed replay nor a partially published portable artifact.
WSR-FT-006 proves portable round-trip parity across the provider fidelity matrix and rejects tampered ordering and overstated fidelity.

Provider conformance uses production registrations, sanitized recorded command-runner fixtures, and deterministic synchronization; WSR-FT-001 through WSR-FT-006 pass without Mock Workers, arbitrary sleeps, or live provider calls.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

The Worker bridge preserves Antigravity's synthesized lifecycle and final-only message provenance. Focused and race-enabled Worker Sessions, Recordings, and WSR-FT-003/004/005/006 coverage passes; make typecheck passes.
